leg_record: unchanged: tsb.p2x.execution_estimate record_version 1 (contracts/result_schema_v1.json leg_fields). A leg made with the v2 contract set carries the v2 contract_set_sha256 and v2 scenario / model versions, hence a different estimate_id; v1 legs are never rewritten
quantity_encoding: unchanged: {value, provenance, reason}; UNAVAILABLE = null + reason, never 0

knowledge_time_classes.STATIC: inputs, contract identity, dataset identity, instrument identity and declared times: known before T
knowledge_time_classes.DECISION: market state with available_at_ms <= T (decision side; usable as a feature-side reference)
knowledge_time_classes.EXECUTION: market state with available_at_ms <= T + latency: POST-DECISION; label side only, never a feature
knowledge_time_classes.UNAVAILABLE_BY_DESIGN: always UNAVAILABLE in a leg (future labels / refused quantities); label side
knowledge_time_classes.REFERENCE: an opaque content id (hash over the whole leg): a join key only, never a feature

knowledge_time_rule: every leg field (nested fields of market_data_age, data_quality and source_refs individually) has exactly one class; an unmapped field refuses the join (join.split_by_knowledge_time). With latency 0, EXECUTION fields equal decision-time state but stay on the label side by class, so one rule covers all scenarios

fields: sha256 of the canonical record without result_id
of the contract set the legs were made with
Quantity DERIVED: decision mid (exit) / decision mid (entry) - 1, cost-free; UNAVAILABLE + reason if a mid is missing

EXACTLY {EXEC-IDEALIZED, EXEC-BASE, EXEC-STRESS}: each {scenario, entry/exit/round-trip ids, net_return Quantity, market_gross_return_at_execution_times Quantity, components {entry, exit: spread_cost_bps, fee_bps, slippage_bps, interaction_bps, total_cost_bps, latency_drift_bps (Quantities with provenance)}, cost_provenance, data_quality_state, coverage {state AVAILABLE|REFUSED, reason, entry_reason, exit_reason}}
{component: {scenario: weakest provenance of entry+exit}} for every component and net_return
scenario_set_result.forbidden: no single collapsed net, price or cost at the top level (net_return, estimated_price, fill_price, price, cost_bps, total_cost_bps refused); a missing net is UNAVAILABLE, never 0; all three scenarios must be present

required.cost_to_gross_ratio: per scenario: total execution cost / gross edge (reported, not thresholded here)
required.turnover_sensitivity: per scenario: how net changes with the number of round trips (cost per round trip x turnover)

economic_success_principle: a success claim must rest on the net figures under EXEC-BASE AND EXEC-STRESS together with execution coverage / refusal, the cost-to-gross ratio and turnover sensitivity
EXEC-IDEALIZED alone never supports a success claim (lower bound only)
no threshold is defined here: success criteria are predeclared separately, before any evaluation, and never chosen on outcomes
